statement:
I, Mazin Marji, acting as the network governance owner, have reviewed the Nornyx Forge agentic-network contract for governed subject revision `git:24b40e998ed738edeffbfe0dafb78833ced82d0a`, the reviewed control-pack commit `git:b02478df11610b10b2f9703cfc9ced4c2c420103`, and the content-addressed contract and evidence digests recorded in `.nornyx/contracts/evidence/review_binding.json`.
I approve this exact agentic-network contract and its declared external-share boundary for local autonomous demonstration and strict Nornyx authorization testing only.
This approval does not authorize any individual high-risk action, external side effect, production deployment, processing of real customer data, use of production credentials, security certification, regulatory compliance claim, or action-specific human approval.
Every high-risk action must remain withheld unless it separately receives an action-specific human approval in addition to a valid Nornyx authorization decision.
Any change to the governed revision, identities, capabilities, memberships, trust zones, protocol targets, approval scopes, evidence requirements, runtime enforcement, external-share boundary, or consequential-action controls invalidates this approval.
